Hi — Fahad here, AI engineer in Dhaka.

I was looking at laserdentalbd.com — Dr. Shihabur Rahman's clinic is genuinely impressive. The 3Shape TRIOS scanner, painless injection technology, Invisalign certification, and Digital Smile Design are international-standard offerings. Two premium locations in Banani and Uttara, and the patient reviews are glowing — Sarah Ahmed's 'I used to be terrified of dentists, but Laser Dental changed everything' is the kind of testimonial that converts.

But here's the gap: booking is phone-only (Uttara 01787-660055, Banani 0177-0000007) with a WhatsApp link. For a clinic offering premium services like dental implants and smile design, patients want to book consultations instantly — not wait for a callback. And with two locations, you need to route patients to the right branch based on their service needs (Banani for cosmetic, Uttara for general, etc.).

I built an AI dental booking agent that handles WhatsApp enquiries 24/7 — it asks what service they need, recommends the right branch and doctor, shows available slots, and confirms the appointment. It also sends pre-appointment preparation instructions and post-treatment follow-up reminders.

Happy to show you a working demo in 15 minutes. No commitment.

Best,
Fahad
